subject: Biology

internalBreakdown.component: Investigatory project, record and viva voce

notes: The document has no learning-outcomes column for Biology, so chapter outcomes are left empty.
Environmental Issues is included but assessed only formatively (see CBSE Reading Material).

chapters.name: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants
topics: development of male and female gametophytes
post-fertilisation events: endosperm and embryo, seed and fruit
significance of seed dispersal and fruit formation

chapters.name: Human Reproduction
topics: microscopic anatomy of testis and ovary
fertilisation, embryo development up to blastocyst, implantation

chapters.name: Reproductive Health
topics: Need for reproductive health and prevention of STDs
birth control: need and methods, contraception and MTP
infertility and assisted reproductive technologies: IVF, ZIFT, GIFT (elementary idea)

chapters.name: Principles of Inheritance and Variation
topics: deviations from Mendelism: incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles and blood groups, pleiotropy
sex determination in humans, birds and honey bee
chromosomal disorders: Down's, Turner's and Klinefelter's syndromes

chapters.name: Molecular Basis of Inheritance
topics: Search for genetic material and DNA as genetic material
gene expression and regulation: lac operon
genome, human and rice genome projects

chapters.name: Evolution
topics: biological evolution and evidences (palaeontology, comparative anatomy, embryology, molecular)
mechanism of evolution: variation (mutation, recombination) and natural selection, types of natural selection

chapters.name: Human Health and Disease
topics: Pathogens and parasites causing human diseases (malaria, dengue, chikungunya, filariasis, ascariasis, typhoid, pneumonia, common cold, amoebiasis, ringworm) and their control

chapters.name: Microbes in Human Welfare
topics: Microbes in food processing, industrial production, sewage treatment and energy generation
microbes as biocontrol agents and biofertilisers

chapters.name: Biotechnology and its Applications
topics: Applications in health and agriculture: human insulin and vaccine production, stem cell technology, gene therapy

chapters.name: Organisms and Populations
topics: Population interactions: mutualism, competition, predation, parasitism
population attributes: growth, birth rate and death rate, age distribution

chapters.name: Ecosystem
topics: pyramids of number, biomass and energy

chapters.name: Biodiversity and its Conservation
topics: Concept, patterns and importance of biodiversity
hotspots, endangered organisms, extinction, Red Data Book
sacred groves, biosphere reserves, national parks, wildlife sanctuaries and Ramsar sites

chapters.name: Environmental Issues
topics: Degradation by improper resource utilisation and maintenance
